fixed_statement:
Let \(F=\{1\}\) and \(L_1=\{1,2,3\}\).
For a flat \(G\), write
\[
V_G:=\Trop(F_7/G\oplus U_{0,G}).
\]
Let
\[
I(V_{\{1\}}):=\{x\in \Dr_1\mid x\subset V_{\{1\}}\}.
\]

The boundary element \(V_{\{1\}}\) is a tropical line in \(\Dr_2\).
\[
|I(V_{\{1\}})|=\mathfrak c.
\]
The boundary element \(V_{L_1}\) lies in \(\Dr_1\) and is the single infinite point where \(x_1=x_2=x_3=\infty\) simultaneously and the other coordinates remain finite.
fixed_proof:
The boundary element \(V_{\{1\}}\) is geometrically a \(1\)-dimensional metric tree with a loop at \(1\) and rays corresponding to parallel classes \(\{2,3\}\), \(\{4,5\}\), and \(\{6,7\}\). Therefore
\[
|I(V_{\{1\}})|=\mathfrak c.
\]
Lemma 2.1 gives the tropical line \(V_{\{1\}}\) and the cardinality of its principal ideal of points. Lemma 2.2 gives the corresponding rank \(1\) boundary point \(V_{L_1}\).
